reviews.author: Zii3
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 10 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Cleverish plot with humor and some romance and mystery. (I rate vertically filmed micro dramas on their own sliding scale). General spoilers below. Made me chuckle or laugh out loud multiple times. Overall smartly written and quite enjoyable and satisfying; left me with a smile on my face. Gu Ming Han's facial expressions as the ML are fantastic and so fun to watch (a large part of the high rewatch value for me).I loved the premise and thought the show did a good job with it. It was fun and interesting that the ML could hear all the FL's thoughts, and the audience gets to hear plenty of the ML's thoughts too. Because the FL gets reborn in the body of a girl that was lazy and desperate for attention, it takes her awhile to change people's opinion of her.The mysteries of who was behind what schemes was pretty quickly obvious to the audience, yet the leads figured things out at a believable rate and in a logical way (especially the ML). Though this has a higher rating on my personal sliding scale, my guess would be that the ML may turn some people off. Because the overall tone of the show stayed light, I enjoyed this despite the ML acting like more of a d*ck than he needed to (with his words) for about 2/3rds of it (not sadistic, though there are choke holds very early on before he starts believing the FL is a different person than before). He does start to redeem himself and I can imagine him fully redeeming himself over time (we just don't see their life past their wedding). His actions improve fairly early on as he gets over his suspicions of the FL and starts to like her, but his words send mixed signals as he tends to mask his intentions; he'll protect her, but then make light of it. Two things I appreciated about this character that many in vertical dramas don't do: 1) It's a process, but the ML is willing to question his perception of the SFL and starts to put his guard up around her even before he fully believes she's as bad as the FL's internal thoughts indicate. 2) Later on, he recognizes in his own thoughts that he has some work to do to win over the FL because of how he's previously acted (though his words still take a while to catch up).There are a couple moments of sexual tension, a couple suggestive lines, and a satisfying lip press kiss near the end. The FL shows and has thoughts about desiring the ML too. Happy ending with their wedding and another brief lip press. All actors were good and fit their parts well. The SFL and SML have some psychological issues and try to murder multiple people to get what they want, but they stay plausible and believable (did not turn into caricatures). Watched with good English subtitles on licensed channel @RomanticDramaTV (浪漫短劇社RomanticDrama) in Nov 2024:https://youtu.be/crwP_GO0OYo?si=kc8O7c1IK5OQ43RJUpdate: I rewatched in May 2025 and it made me laugh out loud multiple times again. I really enjoyed it and didn't fast-forward anything even though I remembered most of the big plot points. I'm pretty sure I'll even watch it again. So I've raised the rating in my list to 9.5 instead of 9. I wish there were just a few more sweet/romantic scenes, but I do appreciate that the story is tightly woven.Watched with good English subtitles on an authorized channel:https://youtu.be/x0aQ0braMxY?si=hw499vK8knUIuByG Read More Was this review helpful to you?

But for romantic chemistry from them is none to be found.Actually there is big plot hole i really annoyed about this drama, its about the FL timeline that messed up.The only redeeming thing about the female antagonist is that she cares about her son. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 This review may contain spoilers Affectionate & playful CP made me watch this drama on repeat In my first month of my vertical Chinese drama exploration, I came across Dramazone Youtube channel. I had become a fan of Sun Yue so I was excited to watch this drama. Oh wow, I love it so much that I watch on repeat. Too bad the link can no longer be found on Youtube.What I liked:1. ML characterisation - I must say I like coquettish MLs and this ML is definitely coquettish. He might be seen as a himbo but he's actually smart. Sun Yue always brings out sunny personality to his characters. That's why I enjoyed this ML.2. FL characterisation - I loved that she was a qipao designer. Sucb a gorgeous collection. I also loved tnat sne was financially independent. She offered to take care of ML. This was my first Ma Qian Qian drama and I liked her acting as she was able to showcase both sassy & serious side of her character.3. Romance - Top notch romance with a lot of kisses, innuendo & affectionate moments. The couple had each other's backs right from the start of their marriage. Ma Qian Qian & Sun Yue seemed so comfortable with each other.4. Supporting character - FL's grandma was so supportive. Even ML's superior at the law firm was comical. I liked FL's bestie & ML's assistant whom looked familiar - are they Zhai Xinran & Wang Yi Lei?5. Styling - I loved the outfits worn by FL, ML & some supporting characters. The characters were quite fashion savvy. My favourite FL outfit is the light pink jacket & mini skirt with cutout at the side.What I disliked:1. FL's admirer - He schemed to get FL's attention that she overlooked ML's call. He knew she was already in relationship with ML.Favourite sceneWhen ML limped towards FL & then they had heart-to-heart conversation Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: The amnesiac youth killer Yue Yao finally embarks on her first killing mission at the age of sixteen, where she is ordered by her master to assassinate the ruthless General He Yun Xing of the Fourteenth Government Office. Yue Yao sneaks into the general's mansion but fails to assassinate He Yun Xing, and she is even tricked by him into becoming his newly-married bride! reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers My wife is a spy and I'm here to protect her trope Since nobody write a review yet, I'll just do one.Basically like any other short cdrama, its fast, straight forward and concise. Nothing much to expect, not that it's a bad thing for someone who looking forward to watch something during their lunch time or commuting to work.Acting wise both ML and FL did a good job especially ML , I can hardly believe that he is not mainstream yet (maybe he already is, I have no idea since I am not following cdrama ent that much).There is only 4 main characters, on which one them is a princess who travel with her friend, just that one male friend. Not even a maid chamber or any maid to accompany her? Which is kinda weird considering that she is a princess. Not the biggest setback since the setting and camera work is pretty good for a low budget drama. No unnecessary love triangles, both 1st and 2nd couple work their way to defeat the evil in 10 min or less runtime for 24 ep. For me I would give it 8/10 , solely due to the fact that main characters delivered their performance quite well within the given script and short story line.
